text.name: Blastoise

abilities.label: Special Powers
abilities.name: Rain Dance
abilities.text: You may play as many Water Energy Cards from your hand as you want on your Pocket Monsters during your turn. This ability cannot be used if Blastoise is Asleep, Paralyzed, or Confused.

attacks.name: Hydropump
attacks.text: For each additional Water Energy Card attached to Blastoise, "Hydropump" deals an extra 10 damage (to a maximum of 20 extra damage).

rules.text: Stack this card on the monster card.

text.flavor: Stats: 2 ft. tall, 100 lbs. The Blastoise often charges its enemies, using its heavy body to trample over and stun them. When in danger, it retreats within its hard shell.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: New Chapter
abilities.text: You can't play this Pokémon in your deck.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Develop a Product
attacks.text: Open any Pokémon TCG box and add the promo card to your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Red Chanchanko
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks (including damage), Abilities, and Trainer cards done to this Pokémon.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: 60 Congratulations!
attacks.text: Flip 60 coins. For each heads, take a present! (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: ____'s Oshawott

attacks.text: Does 100 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

text.name: ____'s Snivy

attacks.text: Heal all damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

text.name: ____'s Tepig

attacks.text: Discard all {Fire} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

text.name: Articuno, Moltres, and Zapdos

attacks.name: Big Bang
attacks.text: Shuffle Articuno, Moltres, and Zapdos into your deck.

text.flavor: Legendary Bird Pokémon. Combined Length: 17'5", Combined Weight: 370 lbs. These legendary bird Pokémon are above electricity, fire, water, and all other elements. #144, #145, #146
